name: Delhi
description: The capital territory of India, a massive metropolitan area in northern India featuring historic landmarks like the Red Fort and India Gate.

name: Mumbai
description: India's largest city and commercial capital, located on the western coast on the Arabian Sea, home to Bollywood and the Gateway of India.

name: Tokyo
description: The capital of Japan and the world's most populous metropolitan agglomeration, blending futuristic technology with historic Shinto and Buddhist shrines.

name: London
description: The capital of England and the United Kingdom, a global cultural, financial, and political capital situated along the River Thames.

name: Paris
description: The capital and largest city of France, situated along the Seine River, internationally famous for art, fashion, gastronomy, and the Eiffel Tower.

name: New York City
description: The most populous city in the United States and a premier global center for finance, culture, diplomacy (UN headquarters), and media.

name: Cairo
description: The capital of Egypt and the largest metropolitan area in the Arab world and Africa, located near the Nile Delta and Giza Pyramids.

name: Beijing
description: The capital of the People's Republic of China, a sprawling metropolis with over three millennia of recorded history, home to the Forbidden City.

name: São Paulo
description: The most populous city in Brazil, the Americas, and the Western and Southern Hemispheres, serving as South America's financial powerhouse.

name: Sydney
description: The capital of New South Wales and the most populous city in Australia, famous for the Sydney Opera House and Sydney Harbour Bridge.
